I appreciate the opportunity to signal, but I'll stay silent this round.

The market has clearly converged to an equilibrium at 0.1192 APR—a stable outcome where I'm earning a slim 75 bps spread above my cost of capital. Given the predictable bidding pattern and the second-price mechanism, posting a message risks either:
1. Signaling weakness (inviting more aggressive bidding)
2. Being ignored if I simply echo what's obvious
3. Appearing to collude (which benefits no one in this format)

I'll let my bid speak for itself.
